historical_pilot_closeout.note: The original three-outcome stop decision is retained as history and was later superseded by full-language criteria plus the compiler-AST semantic foundation.

semantic_authority.boundary: Apple Swift 6.3.3 swiftc compiler-AST facts over one exact dependency-free SwiftPM selected target

global_limits: Semantic facts cover one exact selected target in a dependency-free SwiftPM package under Apple Swift 6.3.3; they are not whole-program or multi-configuration proof.

Conditional compilation, macros/plugins, generated inputs, reflection, selectors, Objective-C or dynamic dispatch, protocol/existential runtime dispatch, external callers, Xcode projects/workspaces, Apple frameworks, resources, dependencies, and mixed-language targets remain unresolved.
Compiler-resolved static structure does not establish runtime reachability, behavior, deletion safety, behavioral equivalence, refactor safety, ABI/release compatibility, or mutation authority.

Native evidence proves only the exact source/configuration hashes, restrictive SwiftPM build, compiler parse and AST, strict Swift Format, direct check, executable smoke, terminal replacement, copied closure, and source preservation recorded by each cohort.
decision_reason: All twenty-two bounded Swift outcomes reach value-tested final artifacts: nine project/lexical and syntax reports, one bounded omnibus report, five compiler-AST semantic read-only reports, one accepted enum proposal, one staged exact-property guard, one target-directory move, one bounded subsystem map, one accepted shadow proposal, and two accepted structure proposals with current and disposable native proof.
